note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The decision is a placeholder sheet; the frame encloses ONLY the supplied range (routes.from..routes.to) and implies no rule about what a review may cover. Relationships are drawn only as supplied: plain relations have no arrowheads; a causal style appears only when the author supplies kind 'causal' (no shipped preset does). Cards describe where each supplied question's section lies relative to the supplied frame (inside / outside, as supplied); nothing is admitted, rejected or decided. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels and traversalOrder are editable.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Five sections, the frame over Sections 2–3 lifted out beside (or below) the decision; plain relations decision–frame, frame–A, frame–B; the tracer runs decision → frame → A → frame → B with the frame enlarged; copies of Sections 2–3 slide into its glass.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: four sections, a frame over Sections 1–2, question A at Section 4 (outside) and B at Section 1 (inside); a supplied sequence link from question A to question B (drawn with an arrowhead and captioned 'sequence as configured'), the decision as focus, and another traversal order.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths and counts: six sections with long tags, a long title, long questions, long component and relation captions, a frame over Sections 2–5 and an eight-step traversal.
